purpose: Portable fixture contracts for repeatable behavioral eval sessions. These describe the repository state the evaluator should provide; they do not pin a specific harness implementation.

web-existing-system.state: Existing non-Material component system with centralized custom design tokens and accessible shared primitives.

web-material3.state: Material 3 project with centralized semantic tokens, shared controls, browser rendering tooling, and compact/expanded layouts.

compose-stable.state: Production Android app pinned to stable Compose Material3 with no approved alpha/experimental dependency upgrade.

wear-stable.state: Wear OS app using androidx.wear.compose:compose-material3 and Wear-specific foundation/navigation artifacts.

flutter-legacy.state: Older Flutter Material app with legacy navigation patterns and widget/golden tests; Material3 migration is incomplete.
